overall_goal: Separate the soaked mushrooms from their liquid using a colander and saucepan.

goals.description: Prepare the saucepan and colander for draining
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a saucepan and sets it up in the sink with a colander on top to prepare for draining the mushrooms.

goals.description: Drain the mushrooms into the saucepan
goals.rationale: The person pours the soaked mushrooms and liquid from the jug into the colander, shaking it to ensure all the liquid drains into the saucepan below.

goals.description: Transfer the drained mushrooms back to the jug and set aside
goals.rationale: The person transfers the drained mushrooms back into the jug, sets the colander aside, and places the jug on the countertop.

goals.description: Move the saucepan with the mushroom liquid to the hob
goals.rationale: The person picks up the saucepan containing the reserved mushroom liquid and places it on the hob for cooking.
